en.title: Ads in ChatGPT don't buy a spot inside the answer
en.caption:
OpenAI just took ChatGPT Ads to 26 more countries, bringing the total to 89. Over 100,000 advertisers have already run campaigns in just over eight months. OpenAI itself says ads don't influence the answer.

In practice, ads buy space next to the answer. Showing up inside it depends on content AI can read and cite.

What I see in companies: they decide media budget without knowing if AI already cites the brand.

For one of Brazil's biggest cosmetics companies, I redid the annual report so ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can read and cite it, with my own log collector. In 15 days: 1,427 reads by AI bots, 553 searches for real questions and 60 people reaching the site by clicking an AI citation.

Measure instead of assuming. First check if AI cites you. Then decide how much to spend on media.

Comment GEO and I'll send you how I did it by DM.
